name: Business Identity Local - Germany
description: Adds German legal-requirement fields (USt-IdNr, Handelsregister number, VAT, Impressum, DSGVO/GDPR, e-commerce) to Business Identity's Local Laws tab.
project_description: Submodule of Business Identity providing German legal-requirement configuration fields via the Business Identity 'Local Laws' tab. Implements hook_business_identity_local_laws (Germany metadata), hook_business_identity_local_laws_fields (USt-IdNr, Handelsregisternummer, VAT number/regime/rates, Impressum details, DSGVO/GDPR settings, AGB/Widerrufsrecht e-commerce URLs, industry certifications, share capital and bank details), hook_business_identity_local_laws_validate (USt-IdNr checksum, German IBAN mod-97, BIC and URL format checks), and real hook_tokens/hook_token_info for [business:local_laws_de_*] tokens. Values are stored under business_identity.settings:local_laws.business_identity_local_de.
